notes.title: 🚨 Patch Update [2.0.4.28] & [Creator 2.0.2] is Live! 🚨
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just rolled out an exciting new patch that’s packed with awesome updates and fixes!

🎣 What’s New?

Dive into an all-new fishing experience with revamped mechanics.
Start your farming journey at Ellondel Farm, where you can now plant, harvest, and sell your crops.
Enjoy the serene sounds of ambient background music in every environment.

🐛 What’s Fixed?

No more overlapping UIs or muted audio on first launch—we’ve squashed those bugs for good!


🛠️ For Our Creators:

The file browser now remembers your last used path, and your most recent avatar preset loads automatically (don’t forget to create new ones!) We also fixed a bunch of annoying bugs that was preventing submissions in some scenarios.


Jump in and explore all the new features and bug fixes waiting for you. As always, thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🚀🎉

Thanks,
The VX Team

notes.title: Patch [2.0.4.27]
notes.content:
Patch [2.0.4.27] - Game Client
===============================

[What's Fixed?]

▶ Minor avatar customization fixes.

▶ The `Bruce` NPC no longer knocks out mounts when a player is knocked out whilst mounted.

▶ Waypoint markers no longer render when a player is close to the target.

[What's Changed?]

▶ Clothing textures and thumbnails are now cached locally to prevent reloading every time.

▶ Improvements to loading times on player apartment textures.

▶ Default key bind for voice chat push to talk is now `Page Down`.

▶ Game UI now scales with the screen resolution by default.

▶ Minor tweaks to mini game mechanics.

[What's New?]

▶ Creator 2.0 Tool is now live and accessible from `Esc` menu.

▶ Clothing Wardrobe in avatar now has a text search feature.

▶ Game Settings now has key bindings for various in-game actions.

▶ Chat now has an auto complete feature for /emotes.

▶ Shortcut bar now has icons for `Marketplace` & `Rankings`.

▶ Local, World & Party chat colour text can now be customized in settings.

Patch [2.0.0] - Creator
=================

▶ Initial Public Release

notes.title: Important Announcement for Piffsy Players!
notes.content:
Dear Piffsy Players,

Thank you for joining us in the exciting world of Piffsy! We are thrilled to see so many of you diving into the game and exploring everything it has to offer.

To ensure that all players can fully enjoy and explore the game without any initial pressures, we have temporarily disabled microtransactions for purchasing in-game currency. This decision was made to allow everyone to experience Piffsy's rich content, mechanics, and community on an even playing field from the start.

Key Details:
Microtransactions for in-game currency are currently disabled and will remain so for a short period.
This will allow you to fully engage with the game's core features and challenges.
We will provide updates on when microtransactions will be re-enabled, so you can plan accordingly.
We believe this approach will foster a fair and engaging environment, ensuring that skill, strategy, and exploration are at the forefront of your experience. Thank you for your understanding and support as we continue to build a vibrant community around Piffsy.

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep enjoying your adventures in Piffsy!

Happy gaming,

The Piffsy Team

notes.title: Piffsy 2.0 is Here! 🌟
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting News: Piffsy 2.0 is Here! 🌟

Dear Piffsy Community,

We are thrilled to announce the long-awaited arrival of Piffsy 2.0, and we cannot thank you enough for your incredible patience and support throughout this development journey. Your feedback from the v1.0 open beta phase was invaluable, and we've taken every suggestion to the drawing board. Today, we are proud to unveil the Piffsy 2.0 official trailer in all it's glory!

🎉 Can You Tell Us About Some Of The New  Stuff In Piffsy 2.0?

✨ Enhanced Features: We've listened to your feedback and implemented numerous enhancements to make your gaming experience even more thrilling.

✨  Revamped Graphics and Animations: Immerse yourself in the stunning visuals of Piffsy 2.0 with upgraded graphics and eye-catching animations, taking your gaming experience to a whole new level.

✨  Expanded Avatar Customization: Express yourself in style with an extended range of avatar customization options. From outfits to accessories, personalize your gaming persona like never before.

✨ Improved User Interface: Enjoy a sleeker and more intuitive interface, ensuring seamless navigation and maximum enjoyment.

✨ New Regions and Challenges: Get ready for exciting new mini games and quests that will keep you gaming for hours.

✨ Exclusive In-Game Events: Stay tuned for special in-game events and competitions that offer unique rewards and a chance to showcase your skills in the Piffsy community.

✨ Optimized Performance: Piffsy 2.0 is faster, smoother, and more responsive than ever before, ensuring a truly immersive gaming experience.
🙏 Thank You for Your Patience

Your patience has been the driving force behind the development of Piffsy 2.0, and we are sincerely grateful for the unwavering support you've shown us. We understand that the road from v1.0 to this moment has been filled with anticipation, and we appreciate your trust in us.

🌈 Learning from Experience

The lessons we've learned from v1.0 have been instrumental in shaping the new and improved Piffsy. Your feedback has guided us in making crucial decisions, and we're confident that the result is a game that exceeds your original expectations.

🔄 Account Continuity

We are delighted to inform you that all accounts from v1.0 have been seamlessly retained. Any currency you had prior to the closure of v1.0 will be loaded into your account, ensuring a smooth transition into the exciting world of Piffsy 2.0.

🚀 Embark on a New Adventure

The wait is over, and the next chapter of the Piffsy journey begins. Thank you for being a vital part of our community. Your enthusiasm and dedication inspire us, and we can't wait for you to explore all that Piffsy 2.0 has to offer.

🎨 Creators Platform: Crafting Your Imagination

With the launch of Piffsy 2.0, we're thrilled to share a special glimpse into the future - the return of the Creators Platform! This beloved feature, cherished in Piffsy 1.0, is making a comeback, promising an even better creative experience. While the Creators Platform won't be available immediately with the launch of Piffsy 2.0, we want you to know that it hasn't been forgotten. Our team is hard at work refining and enhancing this feature, allowing you to design, submit, and sell your custom items in-game.
